ensemble.route: From semantic text only: Cyrillic/Kana/Han alphabetic characters >=15% of alphabetic characters -> multilingual Laya; otherwise English Laya. No oracle language metadata.
ensemble.combine: equal arithmetic mean of calibrated Laya and ModernBERT probability vectors; threshold fitted only on new validation

adjudication-policy.scope: new training and validation candidates with two valid cloud votes and a disagreement with the generation contract

isolation.optimization: Exact cached posting counts; batched fixed-reference cosine with legacy boundary recheck; original sequential cross-split decisions

admission.teacher_policy: Unanimous contract + two teachers, or user-authorized blind agent ruling on complete disagreeing votes; missing votes still discarded

probe.posttrain_rule: tuned validation request F1 must exceed full probe validation request F1 by at least 0.03

dean-adjudication-final.scope: 480 fixed, targeted disagreement candidates: 288 new training and 192 new validation. Each assigned fragment was actually read by one independent agent reviewer, with 160 cases per reviewer. Aggregate schema/coverage/fingerprint checks performed by data_dean. This is not independent multiple-reviewer consensus on every item.
dean-adjudication-final.blindness: Contract labels and original cloud votes were withheld during adjudication. They were associated only after all six judgment files were complete and structurally checked. No adjudicated labels were changed after revealing votes.
limitations: Targeted disagreement sample, not a random sample of all candidates. Teacher agreement counts are not population teacher accuracy estimates.
Signature covers these 480 records and their traceability checks, not unread triagreement candidates or the full dataset.
12 abstentions are not labels and must remain excluded. Missing teacher votes are not authorized for adjudication admission.

The 468 determinate judgments may be associated with new admission records under user authorization, but do not bypass isolation, token length, source/language/prior/style balance, size or shortcut-probe gates.
No final training dataset, model, heldout performance or stage acceptance is certified here.
dean-adjudication-final.pipeline_review_status: Aggregation policy confirmed from parent description; final admission aggregate/code audit pending.

dean-admission-review.method: Manual code review plus AST-extracted pure-function and entirely in-memory finalize checks; no network or model calls. Actual adjudications loader verified only assigned synthetic records. No additional semantic adjudication.

findings.subject: adjudicated_row
findings.assessment: Requires two complete disagreeing registered-teacher votes, binds row id/input fingerprint, discards abstain, and writes a new row retaining contract label, both original votes and ruling. Original candidate objects are not mutated.

findings.subject: adjudications
findings.assessment: Checks assignment rubric/input file hashes, full ID coverage, cross-shard duplicate IDs, ruling fingerprint, allowed labels, reviewer and reason; returns hashes of all six ruling files.

findings.subject: finalize
findings.assessment: Only complete disagreements may use authorized rulings. Missing votes and abstentions remain discarded. Unanimous count is based solely on original contract plus teacher agreement. Agreement denominator is all isolated fully reviewed rows, before balancing; adjudication does not increase its numerator.

findings.subject: balance_generators
findings.assessment: Deterministically caps the larger generator using hash(id), independently of labels or ruling outcome. Final quality audit rechecks generator proportions and all registered distribution/size/style gates after balancing.

reporting_cautions: unanimous_n, agent_adjudicated_n and agent_relabeled_n are pre-generator-balance counts; final_agent_adjudicated_n/final_agent_relabeled_n are post-balance. Report both scopes distinctly.
Unanimous admitted rows preserve contract in their unchanged label; their original votes remain in the frozen combined vote artifact rather than being copied into every admitted row.
A failed quality audit still writes admitted.jsonl as a diagnostic candidate artifact with admission.passed=false; file existence must never be interpreted as training authorization.

final_admission_review.note: admitted.jsonl is the diagnostic result of admission filtering, not a quality-gate pass or training release.

frozen_collection_review.scope: Frozen pre-isolation generation aggregates and cryptographic linkage only; not admitted distribution, semantic quality certification or permission to train. No candidate fragment text was displayed or semantically read for this check.

training_release_review.reason: Final isolation and diagnostic pretraining probe pass, but four predeclared admission checks fail. The fixed-data dilution upper bound remains insufficient. No training or S1 activation is released.

dean-admission-review.final_dean_opinion: Review complete for authorized existing-data closeout. The 480 adjudication records, frozen input linkage, final isolation and new-validation probe linkage are verified. Dataset admission fails training count, new training count, validation request prior and long-dilution minimum. The first-sentence probe passes; the full-probe versus fine-tuned-model F1 gap is not evaluated because no model was trained. Training and S1 activation remain not released. No additional labels, generation, threshold changes or stage E work are authorized by this review.
